description: Client-side script for Payment Entry form in ERPNext, handling form setup, validation, calculations, and interactions with server-side methods.

methods.name: validate_taxes_and_charges
methods.description: Validates the selected tax charge type and references for each tax entry.

methods.name: validate_inclusive_tax
methods.description: Ensures inclusive taxes are correctly configured and refer to previous rows if needed.

methods.name: determine_exclusive_rate
methods.description: Calculates tax fractions for inclusive taxes to determine exclusive rates.

methods.name: get_current_tax_fraction
methods.description: Returns the current tax fraction based on charge type and tax rate.

methods.name: calculate_taxes
methods.description: Computes total taxes and updates tax amounts and totals.

methods.name: get_current_tax_amount
methods.description: Calculates the current tax amount based on charge type and rate.

methods.name: validate_reference_document
methods.description: Validates that reference document types are appropriate for the party type.

methods.name: set_deductions_entry
methods.description: Creates or updates deductions entries for gain/loss or write-off based on difference amount.

methods.name: set_unallocated_amount
methods.description: Calculates and sets the unallocated amount based on total allocated and other amounts.

methods.name: set_total_allocated_amount
methods.description: Sums up allocated amounts from references and updates total allocated fields.

methods.name: set_difference_amount
methods.description: Calculates the difference amount between total party amount and allocated amount.

methods.name: get_outstanding_invoice
methods.description: Opens a dialog to fetch outstanding invoices and related documents.

methods.name: get_outstanding_documents
methods.description: Fetches and populates outstanding reference documents based on filters.

methods.name: allocate_party_amount_against_ref_docs
methods.description: Allocates the paid/received amount across reference documents.

methods.name: set_account_currency_and_balance
methods.description: Fetches and sets account currency and balance for a given account.

methods.name: set_current_exchange_rate
methods.description: Fetches and sets current exchange rate between two currencies.
